propositions: rebar comment and other positional-body commands silently accept flag-like tokens (--body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, causing the intended content to be discarded and exit code 0 to mask the failure

multiple independent sessions have lost work (analysis, findings, attestations) because their comment bodies were replaced with 6-11 byte flag strings, discovered only when downstream verification gates checked for content that was never stored

the failure mode is particularly severe because len(comments) checks pass (a comment exists), stderr is silent, and exit code is 0, so the loss is only discovered on content read, not on write confirmation
args[:min_args] slicing discards surplus positional arguments after a flag-like token is consumed as the body, compounding the silent data loss with a second erasure mechanism
a body argument beginning with - must be rejected with non-zero exit and diagnostic message, unless escaped with -- prefix per convention
